name: (S)-5-oxo-2,5-dihydro-2-f… to nitrite
summary: A 9-step route from (S)-5-oxo-2,5-dihydro-2-furylacetate to nitrite, ingested from Rhea. Every step is curated by Rhea and independently verified here to balance in mass and charge.

reactions.name: nitrate reductase (NADH)
reactions.equation: nitrite + NAD(+) + H2O = nitrate + NADH + H(+)

reactions.name: nitrate reductase (cytochrome)
reactions.equation: 2 Fe(II)-[cytochrome] + nitrate + 2 H(+) = 2 Fe(III)-[cytochrome] + nitrite + H2O

reactions.name: nitrite reductase [NAD(P)H]
reactions.equation: NH4(+) + 3 NAD(+) + 2 H2O = nitrite + 3 NADH + 5 H(+)

reactions.name: 3 propionate 3-nitronate + 3 O2 + H2O = 3 3-oxopropanoate + 2 nitrate + nitrite + H2O2 ...
reactions.equation: 3 propionate 3-nitronate + 3 O2 + H2O = 3 3-oxopropanoate + 2 nitrate + nitrite + H2O2 + 3 H(+)

reactions.name: tRNA(Phe) (7-(3-amino-3-carboxypropyl)wyosine(37)-C(2))-hydroxylase
reactions.equation: 7-[(3S)-3-amino-3-carboxypropyl]wyosine(37) in tRNA(Phe) + 2-oxoglutarate + O2 = 7-(2-hydroxy-3-amino-3-carboxypropyl)wyosine(37) in tRNA(Phe) + succinate + CO2

reactions.name: peptide deformylase
reactions.equation: N-terminal N-formyl-L-methionyl-[peptide] + H2O = N-terminal L-methionyl-[peptide] + formate

reactions.name: nitroalkane oxidase
reactions.equation: a secondary nitroalkane + O2 + H2O = a ketone + nitrite + H2O2 + H(+)
